acquisition_channels.details: Facebook ads to acquire local subscribers; the guest recommends prioritising them.
Instagram videos and carousels support discovery and sponsor sales; the guest says he moved away from face-led reels.
Seasonal restaurant and activity guides are used as referral content.
The guest discusses cross-promoting newsletters in other cities and creating local advertiser offers.
Sponsor sales are relationship-led; the guest describes local marketing coordinators finding the Instagram account and then being sold newsletter ads.

ideas.delivery: The guest and two virtual assistants gather events, draft and edit local updates with AI tools, and send the newsletter three times weekly. Social posts support the newsletter; the guest reviews content and sells sponsorships.

prices: 15 Canadian cents per subscriber at an earlier stage

uk_legal_risk.reason: The transcript recommends cold outreach to local business accounts through social media. In the UK, unsolicited social DMs to individual subscribers, including sole traders, are restricted by PECR; use compliant outreach and distinguish incorporated companies from sole traders.

ideas.other_uk_rules: UK GDPR and PECR apply to subscriber surveys and email marketing lists. The transcript describes advertising rather than a paid subscription, so subscription rules under the DMCC Act do not appear central.
